betterquesting:10.desc:8:
Landing on a charred, fire-scorched planet? Charcoal Logs can't be crafted. Mine them during a landing mission from planets with burnt forests or volcanic activity.

These logs are the source of carbon for the CO2 Scrubber (10050) recipe, and they feed into the Carbon Brick (10002) chain for the Electric Arc Furnace (10004). Bring at least 32 logs per mission, the CO2 Scrubber eats through carbon fast.

Look for planets with Charred Forest biomes, typically high-temperature, low-oxygen worlds. Carbon can be smelted into carbon ingots for the Electric Arc Furnace.

§cWARNING:§f The planet's atmosphere might be flammable. Wear a Space Suit (10049) before mining or you'll catch fire.

§ePS:§f Charcoal logs also work as a decorative block if you're into that sort of thing.
